tsc-notes.scope: CUET TSC facilities and floor labels supplied by the project owner.

faculty-workbook.scope: User-supplied CUET Department/Name/Email/Designation snapshot; not independently verified live appointments.

transport-routine.scope: Owner-supplied bus routine and explicit four-window timetable, checked against UniCircle Transport on 2026-11-16. Route and bus assignments are app-managed configuration.
